small_gate.invalid_controls: Run separately and require ValueError from both APIs.
small_gate.oracle: Audit-owned restricted-growth enumeration and direct projection semantics. Compare complete unordered partition sets and validate every solution witness.
small_gate.sparse_interpretation: found is accepted only when the graph certificate is replayable and the oracle set is exactly its one partition; infeasible is accepted only for an empty oracle set; insufficient_coverage and incomplete remain separate nonclaims.

deadline_and_input_controls: expired deadline yields incomplete without claiming infeasibility
near-expired preprocessing interruption returns a well-formed incomplete record
NaN and positive infinity deadline options raise ValueError
invalid q, k, and contradictory labels are rejected
graph_unit_controls: audit/graph_unit_controls_v1.json; synthetic adjacency only, reported separately from sample-derived inputs.
trace_realizable_sparse_control: structural/sparse_trace_fixtures_v1.json; run data fields only, independently recompute pair edges and direct projections.
capture: All candidate sources, gate source, wrapper source, protocol, manifest, every corpus input and sidecar, and both supplemental control files are snapshotted before each test launch by evidence/capture.py.
performance: No wall-time or memory measurements; wait for explicit master GO before timing.
